utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time should I come by on Saturday, and what kind of repairs do you need help with?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Saturday morning on the front porch works best, and it’s mostly small fixes like patching and hauling. Thanks — if you can bring anyone else along, that’d help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam — I’m still lining up the Saturday porch repair drive, so any help you can bring would mean a lot.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli — I can help at the porch on Saturday and I’ll bring a few supplies too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the logistics for Saturday’s repair drive on the front porch, so a few extra helpers would really make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia — that would be a big help. If you can, please stop by the front porch Saturday; we could really use you.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help with the repair drive Saturday on the front porch—just remind me what time to be there.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Thanks, Oren, that’s great. Please be there by 9 on Saturday morning on the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: How many helpers do you need, and what time should we show up on Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’m hoping for three or four people, and around 9 in the morning would help a lot. I’ll be there on the porch to get everyone started.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Rosa — that would be a big help. I’ll see you Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: You bet, Sam — I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Vik—thanks! I’ll send you the time for the front porch as soon as I’ve got it nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Tess — just let me know the time for Saturday on the front porch, and I’ll help round up a couple more people too.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still sorting the logistics for Saturday’s repair drive on the front porch, so a few extra helpers would really make a difference.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I can help with the front porch repair drive Saturday—just remind me what time to be there.
